synopsis: Chapter 8 identifies RecurDyn, alongside Adams, as a tool offering rigid multibody modeling with contact [f6392]. It also lists RecurDyn among commercial options for full multibody models with contact and a detailed plant, an approach supporting full machine dynamics, actuator and failure analysis, and real-time co-simulation [f6454]. The glossary nevertheless states that RecurDyn is not discussed in the booklet, contradicting its explicit inclusion in Chapter 8 [f15977, f6392, f6454].

relations.note: Chapter 8 explicitly identifies RecurDyn and its modeling capability, contrary to the glossary's absence claim.
Chapter 8 lists RecurDyn as a commercial option despite the glossary claiming no discussion.
Adds detailed-plant applications and a broader tool landscape to the multibody-with-contact capability.
